activity.notes: Pyrrhus was restored to the Epirote throne while still a minor around 307/306 BCE and was driven out around 303/302 BCE. ATLAS uses c.307-c.302 BCE with approximate boundaries to preserve the one-year variation in modern chronologies, and keeps this first reign separate from his existing 297-272 BCE adult reign.

sources.title: Pyrrhus, of Epirus — Oxford Classical Dictionary
sources.citation_text: The Oxford Classical Dictionary states that Pyrrhus reigned as a minor from 307/6 to 303/2 BCE before being driven out.
